source_lines.32: Let $R$ be a commutative ring. If $M$ is free with basis $(e_i)_{i\in I}$ and $N$ is free with basis $(f_j)_{j\in J}$, then $M\otimes_RN$ is free with basis
source_lines.36: Equivalently, the canonical map $R^{(I\times J)}\to M\otimes_RN$ sending the standard basis vector at $(i,j)$ to $e_i\otimes f_j$ is an isomorphism. This includes an empty basis in either factor.
source_lines.40: **Given:** A commutative ring $R$ and free modules $M,N$ with bases indexed by $I,J$.
